# codebone

> The official GitHub repository for **[codebone](https://codeb.one)**. codebone is a high-performance architecture context engine and native Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that builds a live semantic graph of your codebase and delivers surgical architectural context to AI coding agents.

- **Official Website**: https://codeb.one
- **Official GitHub Repository**: https://github.com/palusc/codebone
- **Benchmark & Token Comparison**: https://github.com/palusc/codebone-benchmark
- **License**: MIT
- **Platform**: macOS (Apple Silicon Metal GPU native) · Cross-platform Engine

---

## What is codebone?

codebone solves the context-window problem for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini / Antigravity, Codex, Windsurf). Instead of dumping dozens of source files into prompts or relying on fuzzy vector embeddings that miss systemic relations, codebone maintains a real-time semantic knowledge graph of your project.

Whenever you save a file (`Cmd + S`), codebone automatically extracts 5 architectural dimensions using an embedded local model running on Apple Silicon Metal GPU:
1. **Database Models & Tables** (entities persisted by each module)
2. **API Routes & Endpoints** (HTTP methods, paths, contracts)
3. **Events & Webhooks** (domain events emitted and handled)
4. **Business Domains** (high-level systemic groupings)
5. **Logical Flow Summary** (concise explanation of role in the system)

AI assistants access this graph instantly via the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or a local HTTP API in ~2,000 tokens — saving **~80% token overhead** and preventing hallucinations.

---

## Key Capabilities

- **100% Local & Private**: All inference and SQLite index storage stay on your machine. Zero code or telemetry sent to the cloud.
- **MCP Native**: Integrates seamlessly with Claude Code, Cursor, Antigravity IDE (Gemini), Codex, Windsurf, and custom agent harnesses.
- **The `cb` Shortcut**: Simply type `cb` in your AI chat to inject architecture maps, `cb: question` to query domain structures, or `codebone_tldr()` to get whole-project summaries.
- **Battery-Aware Live File Watching**: FSEvents watcher with automatic throttling (0.5s on AC power, 15s on battery).
- **Scan Controls & Live ETA**: Menubar status display with dynamic remaining time estimates (`~14s`), plus pause, resume, and cancellation controls.
- **Multi-Project Workspace**: Monitor and switch across multiple repositories from a single unified macOS menu bar interface.

---

## MCP Server Tools & Usage

The `codebone-mcp` server provides the following tools for AI coding agents:

- `cb`: Injects the live high-level architecture, active business domains, and systemic connections into agent context.
- `cb_query`: Queries models, routes, events, and relations for a specific feature or domain.
- `cb_file`: Returns semantic context, incoming/outgoing connections, and domain metadata for a specific file.
- `codebone_tldr`: Returns an instant whole-codebase architectural executive summary.
- `codebone_status`: Returns active index statistics, node counts, and watcher health.

---

## Quickstart

### Installation on macOS
1. Download `codebone.app` from https://codeb.one or https://github.com/palusc/codebone/releases.
2. Drag to `/Applications` and open.
3. Click the 🦴 icon in your menu bar → **Select Project Folder...**.
4. Click **Connect Coding Agent (MCP)...** to auto-configure Claude, Cursor, Antigravity, or Codex.

### CLI & Source
```bash
git clone https://github.com/palusc/codebone.git
cd codebone
./install.sh
```

## Repository Structure & Documentation

- [README.md](file:///Users/paul/Desktop/merge/codebone/README.md): Primary documentation, visual diagrams, and benchmarks.
- [CHANGELOG.md](file:///Users/paul/Desktop/merge/codebone/CHANGELOG.md): Version history and feature milestones.
- [src/service.py](file:///Users/paul/Desktop/merge/codebone/src/service.py): Core orchestration, background scanning, ETA calculation, and watcher.
- [src/storage.py](file:///Users/paul/Desktop/merge/codebone/src/storage.py): SQLite semantic entity index and graph database.
- [src/server.py](file:///Users/paul/Desktop/merge/codebone/src/server.py): Local REST API and MCP bridge for AI agents.
- [src/modules.py](file:///Users/paul/Desktop/merge/codebone/src/modules.py): Multi-agent MCP configurations (Claude, Cursor, Antigravity, Codex).
